items.title: Actuary
items.description: A specialized mathematician who uses statistics to calculate risks, premiums, and mortality rates for the insurance company.

items.title: Annuity
items.description: A financial contract where the insurer guarantees to pay a regular income stream to the policyholder, typically during retirement.

items.title: Surrender Value
items.description: The amount paid by the insurance company to the policyholder if they decide to terminate the policy before maturity.

items.title: Underwriting
items.description: The process by which an insurance company evaluates the risk of insuring a person and decides the premium to charge.

items.title: Premium
items.description: The financial consideration or amount paid by the insured to the insurer in exchange for taking over the risk.
